Button ingots were prepared by arc-melting in 1 atm argon five or six times to homogenize the compositions throughout the ingots and were then arc-melted again two to three times to cast the samples into bars.
The bars were finally annealed at 1870 K under vacuum for 100 h, which ensured the equilibrium microstructures.

attributes.composition: W 13 mol%, Si less than 1 mol%

evidence.section: 3.1. Microstructures and compositions of each phase
evidence.quote: The Nb–10W–10Si–xB alloys consist of primary Nb SS dendrites and a fine scale eutectic of NbSS/5–3 silicide. The NbSS particles in the eutectic are very small compared with the primary dendrites.

evidence.section: 3.1. Microstructures and compositions of each phase
evidence.quote: The bright phase is the Nb-base solid solution (referred to as NbSS hereafter) and the dark phase is the (Nb, W)5Si3 silicide (referred to as 5–3 silicide hereafter).

evidence.quote: Nb–10W–10Si– xB alloys show two-phase microstruc- tures composed of the primary Nb SS and a eutectic of secondary NbSS and 5–3 silicide.

attributes.morphology: longer crack formed by debonding of the interface between the primary NbSS and the silicide

evidence.quote: The longer crack, which formed by debonding of the interface between the primary NbSS and the silicide, is denoted as the main-microcrack.

attributes.morphology: shorter and thicker crack formed by separation of the secondary NbSS particles from the silicide matrix in the eutectic or fractured NbSS particles

evidence.quote: The shorter and thicker crack formed by the separation of the secondary NbSS particles from the silicide matrix in the eutectic or the fractured NbSS particles is called the sub-microcrack

phases_and_microstructures.name: ductile-brittle Nb SS and 5-3 silicide microstructure

evidence.quote: With the ductile-brittle Nb SS and 5-3 silicide microstructures, the interface plays a key role in damage and fracture at both room and high temperatures.

Based on the solid solution strengthening principle, more solidified B in the silicide undoubtedly obstructs the movement of dislocations, thereby, improves the capability of the strain hardening and strength of the Nb–10W–10Si at the high temperature.
the Nb SS/5–3 silicide microstructure is in accordance with the typical ductile phase toughening mechanism
Transgranular cleavage and interface debonding occurring in a shear manner are the failure modes at room and high temperatures, respectively.
